title: CONTRIBUTING_zh.md: all URLs use full-width colons (：), breaking links and copy-paste commands
body: Every URL in CONTRIBUTING_zh.md (12 lines, 13 occurrences) uses the full-width colon '：' (U+FF1A) instead of ':', e.g. line 11: `https：//github.com/orgs/agentscope-ai/projects/2`. GitHub does not auto…
